title: Make Memories default photos shareable via static assets

requirements.summary: Ship the 6 uploaded photos as frontend static assets and use them as the default images in the Memories heart-frame gallery so they appear for any visitor.
acceptanceCriteria: The 6 uploaded images are included in the deployed build as static files (not dependent on localStorage).
Opening the shared link on a different device/browser (fresh session) shows all 6 uploaded photos in the Memories section by default.
The heart-shaped frames and existing gallery layout remain unchanged.

requirements.summary: Ensure local uploads are optional personalization that override the shared defaults per slot, and clearing a slot restores the new shared default photo rather than the old generated placeholder.
acceptanceCriteria: In a fresh session with empty localStorage, each slot resolves to one of the 6 new static photos (not the old generated placeholders).
If a user uploads a new photo into a slot, that slot immediately shows the uploaded photo for that user/session, and persists via localStorage as it does today.
Using the Clear/Remove action restores the slot back to the corresponding new default static photo (the uploaded set), not the old generated placeholder.

file_operations.description: Harden localStorage initialization/migration so stored values never block defaults: normalize to 6 slots, treat missing/invalid entries as empty, and ignore any stored values that reference the old generated placeholder assets so the new static defaults always appear when no real upload exists.

Expose an explicit per-slot 'isCustom' signal (or equivalent) so the UI can reliably show the Clear/Remove control only when a user has uploaded a custom photo, regardless of what the default static asset paths are.

Update custom-photo detection to use the hook-provided 'isCustom' (instead of checking the src prefix) so defaults are never misclassified and the Clear/Remove action correctly restores the new static default image while keeping the existing heart-frame styling and grid layout intact.
